shorts.title: What you will learn: Constructors
shorts.hook: Make every object ready from the first moment.
shorts.script: Make every object ready from the first moment. Today we make objects that start in a good state. A constructor runs the moment an object is born. A constructor is a special function. It has the same name as the class, and it has no return type. It runs when an object is made. A class can have several constructors with different parameters. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: What you will learn: Constructors.

shorts.title: Constructors in one minute
shorts.hook: A constructor is a special function.
shorts.script: A constructor is a special function. It has the same name as the class, and it has no return type. It runs when an object is made. A class can have several constructors with different parameters. If you write none, the compiler gives you an empty default one. If you write any, it does not. Think of a new phone that comes with the setup already done. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Constructors in one minute.

shorts.title: Inside the second program
shorts.hook: One constructor has two default values.
shorts.script: One constructor has two default values. No arguments: the name is Unknown and the age is one. One argument: the age is still one. Two arguments: both defaults are replaced. The output has three lines. The program prints Unknown one, Moti one, and Kali four. A constructor runs when an object is made. It has the class name and no return type. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Inside the second program.

shorts.title: Bug of the Day: No default constructor
shorts.hook: Can you spot the bug in constructors?
shorts.script: Can you spot the bug in constructors? Bug of the Day. The class has only a two-value constructor. Main makes a point with no values. The compiler says no matching function for call to Point. When you write any constructor, the free default one disappears. Add your own. When you write any constructor, the compiler stops making the empty default one. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Bug of the Day: No default constructor.

shorts.title: Pun and challenge
shorts.hook: Can you write a Rectangle constructor in constructors?
shorts.script: Can you write a Rectangle constructor in constructors? The constructor told the object, do not worry. I will get you started. Write a class called Rectangle with width and height. Add a constructor with two values and a function that returns the area. Write your answer in the comments. A constructor runs when an object is made. It has the class name and no return type. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Pun and challenge.
